_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 63 (SkyGate) — we built a Knowledge Base PORTAL right into the dashboard. There's a new 'Knowledge Base' tab: sign in with a magic link (Sam or Malone) and it opens our curated CPL Knowledge Base for clean reading. Even better, signed-in folks get a '✍️ New doc' button — write or PASTE notes, optionally drop in attachments (PDF, Word, Excel, images, or plain text), let Claude polish it into a tidy Knowledge-Base page, and commit it to GitHub as yourself (no coding, no tokens). Five small PRs (#464–#468), all live. Two quick asks below: Sam, kick the tires on the 5 attachment types; Fable (next session), confirm the in-browser file readers behave in the wild. The data/CCR + TMC clean-up lanes are otherwise paused and waiting — docs/session_64_handoff.md.

items.text: The new Knowledge Base tab is LIVE — sign in with your magic link. Try the ✍️ New doc composer: write or paste notes, attach a file or two (plain text, PDF, Word, Excel, or a screenshot), hit ✨ Polish with Claude, then 'Open in GitHub →' to commit it as yourself. Please smoke-test ALL FIVE attachment types and flag anything that throws a red error chip. One decision for you: only the dashboard's copy of the portal got these new features — should we keep the knowledge-base repo's copy in sync too, or treat the dashboard copy as the canonical one?

First Light's anonymous reflections can now become a gentle weekly 'musings' digest for our Obsidian vault (kept private — never on the public site). It's READY; the only thing it needs is the service key on the cpl-knowledge-base repo. One-time step: add an Actions secret named SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (the same Supabase service-role key the dashboard's daily sync uses) to cpl-knowledge-base. A sibling Claude session is wiring the weekly job there — ping it once the secret's in.

Pick your college on the TMC Builder tab — every TMC shows whether you already have that ADT approved (✓ Approved / ⏳ In progress / ◐ Teach-out, with the control number + approval date), and opening one shows a banner up top. With 'All colleges' selected, each TMC shows how many CA colleges already have it. Spot-check a few of your college's against what you know — flag anything that looks wrong (it dedupes old→new, so a replaced degree shows the new one).

The C-ID discrepancies (rows whose C-ID isn't in our reference) now show a ⚠ flag inline. Still on offer: an exportable report of those discrepancies you could hand to the C-ID team. Say the word and Fable builds it.

✨ Suggested merges (data lane, still live): groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, Ballet, and now ECE/EMT/CNA/HVAC/LVN) — divider words AND abbreviations fold. Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Popup tools: '➕ Add more courses by keyword', the 🏷 'match strength' slider, title-cleanup on a different target, and a 'Completion note' box.

Still queued: the 🏷 title-similarity lane (~5,457 groups). Say the word and Fable DRY-RUNs a high-cosine, cross-college, band-gated pass 2 (reversible, marker automerge-titlelane-v1) for your review before anything applies.

395 college course titles carry encoding garbage at the source. The dashboard shows them repaired with a '⚠ fix in COCI' chip; the campaign list is kb/coci_title_corrections.json — take it to the colleges when ready.

Verify the KB-portal attachment extractors work in a real browser. pdf.js / mammoth / SheetJS + the canvas image-downscale are browser-only — CI only covers the pure logic in composer_util.js. If Sam reports a file type erroring, the usual cause is an esm.sh path in kb-portal/app.js (ATT_LIB) — a one-line fix. Also resolve the bundle-divergence decision once Sam answers (backport the tab+composer+attachments to cpl-knowledge-base/kb-portal/, or declare the tracker copy canonical). Full context: docs/kb_portal_lessons.md + docs/session_64_handoff.md.

NEXT CCR lever (SkyLion's rec): the morphological-variant pass — Medical Assisting vs Medical Assistant, and the -ing/-ant/-ology family. The whole-phrase synonym map can't express a shared STEM, so scope a measured, suggestions-only pass (lemmatize/stem the title token before _sug_sig, or a targeted stem-pair map) and MEASURE regroup impact + over-merge before committing. Its own dry-run PR; cron/dispatch republishes.

Data lane (paused): lower the member-join title Jaccard 0.5 → ~0.4 so more raw college courses attach per identity. kb/README mandates MEASURING member-row flips FIRST — prototype the title-filtered raw-list join, count attach/detach at 0.4 vs 0.5, sample the 0.3–0.5 band, present before committing. Its own measured PR + dispatch.

On Sam's go: DRY-RUN title-lane pass 2 — `python3 kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py --pass2-title` (receipt kb/automerge_out/<date>-titlelane/). Present counts; apply only on sign-off, then re-key Supabase via the supabase-rekey workflow + dispatch. (Deferred carryover also tracked in the handoff: the Z future-mint half + the per-row auto-merge revert.)

TMC Builder follow-ups: (1) the TAXONOMY follow-up — harden kb/college_short_names.json with the COCI-program aliases now in tmc/_build_college_adts.py's PROGRAM_COLLEGE_ALIASES + regen college_short_names.js; (2) ADT overlay REFRESH on a fresh COCI program extract (drop CSV in tmc/source_data/, bump SRC_CSV, run tmc/_build_college_adts.py); (3) C-ID-coverage hint + a title-similarity 'suggested (verify)' fill for sparse-C-ID colleges; (4) the C-ID-discrepancy export report; (5) faculty-verify the 45 draft TMCs.
